audit.why: Riot text, E: "creates an ice claw that deals magic damage. Reactivating this ability transports Lissandra to the claw's current location." The root is Ring of Frost (W) at 450 range; the stun is Frozen Tomb (R) cast on an enemy.
audit.corrected: Level 6 rewritten as Glacial Path into a 450-range Ring of Frost root, with Frozen Tomb as the stun, and Spirit Rush as the answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions absent: Frozen Tomb self-cast makes Lissandra untargetable and invulnerable while healing her, and Ring of Frost only reaches 450. The page also invents "the Claw block" as a self-peel tool, which Glacial Path does not do.
audit.why: Riot text, R: "If cast on Lissandra, she encases herself in dark ice, healing herself while becoming untargetable and invulnerable." Dumping a Charm combo into that window wastes all of it, and the heal wants Grievous Wounds. Ring of Frost is 450 range on 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s — outside it, her all-in has no opener.
